proposed_comments.title: Keep native and Settings hotkey slots aligned
proposed_comments.body:
### Keep native and Settings hotkey slots aligned

**Severity:** `critical`

**Affected code:** `src/modules/AdvancedPaste/AdvancedPasteModuleInterface/dllmain.cpp`, `src/settings-ui/Settings.UI.Library/AdvancedPasteAdditionalActions.cs`, `src/settings-ui/Settings.UI.Library/AdvancedPasteSettings.cs`, and `src/settings-ui/Settings.UI/ViewModels/ShortcutConflictViewModel.cs`.

**Problem:** Adding `text-case` to the native traversal makes hotkey IDs depend on the shape of persisted `additional-actions` JSON. Settings defaults omitted or null groups and leaves, while native `read_settings` skips missing groups and `process_additional_action` skips non-object values or absent leaf shortcuts. Their slot counts can diverge, shifting Text Case or custom-action conflicts to the wrong action or localized header. The coaching shortcut also needs the same enabled, non-zero-key condition and position on both sides, even when its parent action is hidden.

**Why it matters:** A valid older or partial settings file can cause conflict metadata and native hotkey routing to refer to different actions.

**Suggested change:**
1. In `dllmain.cpp`, traverse known additional groups and leaves in the fixed depth-first order used by `AdvancedPasteAdditionalActions.GetAllActions()`, rather than enumerating arbitrary JSON properties.
2. For every known leaf, append exactly one native slot, using a disabled placeholder when its group, value or shortcut is absent or malformed; reserve all ten Text Case positions. Do not insert a leaf twice when it has a shortcut.
3. Keep the optional Fix Spelling coaching slot immediately after that leaf on both sides when coaching is enabled and its key is non-zero, including when the parent is hidden.
4. In `ShortcutConflictViewModel`, calculate the start of custom-action headers from the same fixed Settings accessor count, including the optional coaching slot, instead of the hard-coded ID threshold.
5. Cover v1, null and incomplete groups, hidden coaching, and custom actions with ordered native/Settings slot and localization assertions.

**Verification:** Build `AdvancedPasteModuleInterface` and Settings; load an older file omitting `fix-spelling-and-grammar`, a null or incomplete `text-case` group, hidden Fix Spelling with coaching enabled, and a custom action. Confirm each conflict and direct shortcut is labeled and routed to its actual action.

confidence.rationale: The pinned native/managed traversal differs on omitted and null groups; the earlier exact-upstream correction candidate built, but no safe standalone current-diff replacement covers its unchanged native and managed sites.

proposed_comments.title: Include Text Case shortcuts in Shortcut Guide
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: PowerToysShortcutsPopulator.cs is not changed by this PR, so there is no current RIGHT-side range for the required integration.
proposed_comments.body:
### Include Text Case shortcuts in Shortcut Guide

**Affected code:** `src/modules/ShortcutGuide/ShortcutGuide.Ui/Helpers/PowerToysShortcutsPopulator.cs`, `src/settings-ui/Settings.UI.Library/AdvancedPasteTextCaseAction.cs`, and `src/settings-ui/Settings.UI/Strings/en-us/Resources.resw`.

**Problem:** Shortcut Guide populates Advanced Paste shortcuts from an explicit list. The list includes existing core, file, and transcode actions but none of the ten new Text Case leaves. A configured Text Case shortcut will work in Advanced Paste but will not appear in Shortcut Guide.

**Why it matters:** Users rely on Shortcut Guide to discover configured global shortcuts; omitting these actions makes the new feature inconsistent with the existing Advanced Paste shortcuts.

**Suggested change:**
1. In `PowerToysShortcutsPopulator.Populate`, add a `TextCase.IsShown` branch after the existing Advanced Paste action groups.
2. Append each of the ten Text Case leaf shortcuts only when that leaf is shown.
3. Use the corresponding existing localized header resource and the existing Advanced Paste module label.
4. Add Shortcut Guide coverage proving shown Text Case shortcuts are emitted and hidden leaves are not.

**Verification:** Enable Text Case actions, assign shortcuts, open Shortcut Guide, and confirm each enabled action appears with its localized name while disabled actions do not.

confidence.rationale: Shortcut Guide uses an explicit action list and currently has no Text Case entries; the validated candidate adds the complete integration.

proposed_comments.title: Add the vendored Unicode notice to the root notice file
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: NOTICE.md is not changed by this PR, so there is no current RIGHT-side range for the required release-notice update.
proposed_comments.body:
### Add the vendored Unicode notice to the root notice file

**Affected code:** `NOTICE.md`, `src/modules/AdvancedPaste/UnicodeData/LICENSE.txt`, and `src/modules/AdvancedPaste/UnicodeData/SentenceBreakProperty.txt`.

**Problem:** This PR vendors Unicode `SentenceBreakProperty.txt` and generated data derived from it, but the repository's root `NOTICE.md` has no Advanced Paste or Unicode-data entry. Its existing utility sections are the project's central place for third-party notices; the sibling source license does not update that central list.

**Why it matters:** Without the root entry, a reader of the project's central third-party notices will not find the attribution for this newly incorporated data.

**Suggested change:**
1. Add Advanced Paste to the utilities listed by `NOTICE.md`.
2. Add an Advanced Paste section containing the Unicode data source and the Unicode License V3 notice from `UnicodeData/LICENSE.txt`.
3. Keep the source and copyright year consistent with the vendored Unicode 17 data.

**Verification:** Compare the new root entry against `UnicodeData/LICENSE.txt`; check whether the product package includes the root `NOTICE.md` and, if it does not, include the required notice in its distributed documentation.

confidence.rationale: The repository vendors Unicode data and its license but omits the corresponding root distribution notice.
